description: This file declares the ExceptionHandler class for handling crash exceptions and generating minidumps on Linux systems, including callback types, configuration, and methods for crash handling and dump generation.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Class for managing crash exception handling and minidump creation, including setting callbacks, writing dumps, and handling signals.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Immediately writes a minidump of the current process state.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpForChild
methods.description: Writes a minidump of a specified child process.

methods.name: HandleSignal
methods.description: Handles crash signals from signal handlers.
